lowerBoundExplanation: Every maximal spherical subgroup must act freely on a torsion-free transitive coset action. Its orbits therefore have size |W_T|, so the action degree is divisible by every |W_T| and hence by their lcm.

certifiedClaims: algebraic dotted values e=(1+sqrt(13))/4 and d=sqrt(2(5+sqrt(13)))/4
exact normal Gram rank and signature

sourceSystem.description: Coxeter matrix transcribed from Jacquemet and Tschantz, Figure 3, for the unique compact hyperbolic Coxeter 5-cube.

warnings: This certificate encloses numerical Lorentz residuals in intervals. PCA projections remain visualization-only.
Interval-certified reflection residuals are available; browser rendering still uses numerical coordinates.

geometry.source: Jacquemet and Tschantz, All hyperbolic Coxeter n-cubes, arXiv:1803.10462, Figure 3 and Section 4.2.2.

sourceSystem.name: Compact hyperbolic Coxeter 5-cube (Jacquemet-Tschantz Gamma1)
notes: The graph is the unique compact hyperbolic Coxeter 5-cube Gamma_1 from Jacquemet-Tschantz, Figure 3.
Unlabeled solid Coxeter graph edges are m=3; omitted edges are m=2; dotted edges are represented as Coxeter-matrix 'inf' entries.
Dotted diagonal edges (g2,g8) and (g6,g9) use cosh d = sqrt(2(5+sqrt(13)))/4.
Dotted boundary edges (g0,g1), (g3,g4), and (g5,g7) use cosh e = (1+sqrt(13))/4.

sourceRefs.citation: Matthieu Jacquemet and Steven T. Tschantz, All hyperbolic Coxeter n-cubes, Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A 158 (2018), 387-406.
sourceRefs.notes: Supports the compact 5-cube Coxeter graph Gamma_1 and its dotted-edge weights.

warnings: Certified source transcription, algebraic dotted weights, and exact Gram rank/signature are included. Lorentzian normal coordinates and a chamber basepoint are computed numerically from normalGram for visualization.
